automation_name: AI Security Wiki Topic News Collector

cutoff_window.policy: Include only public items published or visibly updated inside the exact 48-hour run window. Exclude missing, ambiguous, future-dated, boundary-only, duplicate, or non-AI-security records.

searched_topics: agent and tool security, including MCP, plugins, browsers, delegated authority, and autonomous action
identity, authentication, authorization, credentials, and least privilege
model, dataset, dependency, artifact, runtime, cloud, hardware, and deployment supply chains
threat modeling, red teaming, security evaluation, assurance, monitoring, and release gates
AI security standards, regulation, governance, audit evidence, and risk management
public AI security incidents, mitigations, patches, disclosures, and lessons learned

routing_context.routing_rule: Broad AI entities, products, companies, frameworks, models, MCP servers, and general AI-development practices route upstream; this artifact keeps only the security-specific facts, affected boundary, mitigation, and ingest routing notes for ai-security-wiki.

collection_methods.notes: Used lastModifiedStartDate=2026-09-18T23:32:26.000Z and lastModifiedEndDate=2026-09-20T23:32:26.000Z. Later repeated keyword calls returned HTTP 429 for several keywords after useful results were captured.

qualifying_findings.title: SxDevOps MCP STDIO server command injection
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: CVE Services records command injection in aiyiyi121 SxDevOps 1.0 and 1.1, affecting subprocess.Popen in backend/aiops/services.py for the MCP STDIO Server Management component. Manipulation of endpoint_or_command can be initiated remotely, and the record names patch 2b4bf8585c3e731e7a8af30801ea46680bc783f9.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: CVE Services primary record with VulDB technical reference and public issue-tracker reference.
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: aiyiyi121 SxDevOps 1.0 and 1.1; MCP STDIO Server Management command-launch path.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: MCP server management is a delegated tool-execution boundary; argument injection into a stdio server launcher can convert tool configuration or remote requests into host command execution.

upstream_routing.ai_wiki: Broad SxDevOps or MCP server catalog context, if needed.
upstream_routing.ai_dev_wiki: General MCP server development practice, if needed.
upstream_routing.ai_security_wiki: MCP stdio server command-injection boundary and patch evidence.

qualifying_findings.confidence_notes: High confidence on CVE publication date and affected boundary; fixed-version semantics should be rechecked during ingest because the CVE names a patch hash rather than a release.
follow_up_actions: Check the issue and patch hash during ingest for release or tag mapping.

qualifying_findings.title: nexus-mcp nexus_reauth command injection
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: CVE Services records command injection in 0-Gaurav-0 nexus-mcp commit aed0026e7ac1f23dc940e46e9fd3a2da6904f914. The affected nexus_reauth MCP tool calls child_process.exec in src/auth/browser.ts with attacker-manipulable url input. The record says the exploit is public and the project had not responded.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: CVE Services primary record with VulDB technical reference and public issue-tracker reference.
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: nexus-mcp rolling release at commit aed0026e7ac1f23dc940e46e9fd3a2da6904f914; nexus_reauth MCP tool.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: Authentication helper tools inside MCP servers can become command-execution surfaces if they shell out with untrusted URL input.

upstream_routing.ai_security_wiki: Tool-auth command injection and public exploit status.

qualifying_findings.confidence_notes: High confidence for the disclosure record; release remediation is unknown because the project uses rolling releases and the CVE says no response yet.
follow_up_actions: During ingest, preserve unresolved remediation status if no fixed commit or release is available.
Cross-link with MCP shell/command policy pages if synthesized.

qualifying_findings.title: mcp-file-analyzer CSV tool path traversal
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: CVE Services records path traversal in 00Kisumi00 mcp-file-analyzer up to commit 84740852f0cf0cf5db4781b1ca6d7c6a6d210405. The affected analyze_csv_data MCP tool in main.py lets filename manipulation traverse paths. The record says remote exploitation is possible and a public exploit exists.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: CVE Services primary record with VulDB technical reference and issue-tracker reference.
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: mcp-file-analyzer through commit 84740852f0cf0cf5db4781b1ca6d7c6a6d210405; analyze_csv_data MCP tool.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: File-analysis tools offered to agents must confine input paths; traversal can expose host files through an agent-readable analysis tool.

upstream_routing.ai_security_wiki: Agent file-tool containment and public exploit evidence.

qualifying_findings.title: 03-lovepreetSingh MCP create_file path traversal
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: CVE Services records path traversal in 03-lovepreetSingh MCP up to commit f95d035c5317fad81af9828286631053ccb23546. The affected create_file function in app/api/mcp/route.ts allows filePath/content manipulation, can be exploited remotely, and has public exploit material.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: CVE Services primary record with VulDB technical reference and public issue-tracker reference.
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: 03-lovepreetSingh MCP through commit f95d035c5317fad81af9828286631053ccb23546; create_file API route.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: Agent-exposed file creation is a host-integrity boundary; path traversal can let an MCP caller write outside the intended workspace.

qualifying_findings.title: ACE-MCP get_file_snippet projectRootPath traversal
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: CVE Services records path traversal in ACE-MCP versions 4.10.0 through 4.10.8. The get_file_snippet tool accepts projectRootPath and filePath; the CVE says isPathInsideProjectRoot only checks filePath against the attacker-chosen root, so setting projectRootPath to a sensitive directory can bypass the guard.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: CVE Services primary record with VulDB technical reference and public issue-tracker reference.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: Workspace roots are authority boundaries for coding and analysis agents; accepting caller-chosen roots can expose arbitrary host snippets through a benign-looking file snippet tool.

upstream_routing.ai_wiki: Broad ACE-MCP entity context, if needed.
upstream_routing.ai_security_wiki: Workspace-root trust boundary and file-read containment.

qualifying_findings.confidence_notes: High confidence from the CVE text because it includes the bypass mechanism; fixed release is not present in the captured record.

qualifying_findings.title: MCPHub template import privilege management flaw
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: CVE Services records improper privilege management in samanhappy MCPHub up to 1.0.32. The affected importTemplate function in src/services/templateService.ts handles the Template Import Endpoint. The record says remote exploitation and public exploit material are available, and upgrade to 1.0.33 fixes the issue via patch 18a4467bc4ec6390b1f841d8a468a37e9922f837.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: CVE Services primary record with VulDB technical reference and public issue-tracker reference.
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: samanhappy MCPHub 1.0.0 through 1.0.32; Template Import Endpoint; fixed in 1.0.33.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: Template import is an agent/tool supply-chain boundary because imported templates can carry executable or privileged tool configuration into an MCP hub.

upstream_routing.ai_security_wiki: Privilege management and template import supply-chain boundary.

qualifying_findings.confidence_notes: High confidence on version boundary and fixed version from CVE text; ingest should verify whether the VulDB 'RCE' submit label reflects the public issue details.
follow_up_actions: Reconcile improper-privilege wording against issue and patch details before creating a durable leaf.
Deduplicate with existing MCPHub advisory cluster only if this is part of the same template-import flaw.

qualifying_findings.title: Tencent BrowserSkill local WebSocket origin bypass
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: CVE Services records an authentication bypass in Tencent BrowserSkill through 0.3.0. The local daemon WebSocket origin validation accepts any chrome-extension origin with 32 characters in range a-p, letting attackers register a malicious extension as a browser client and intercept or manipulate page content, DOM, and screenshots returned to the AI agent.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: CVE Services primary record with issue, code, and VulnCheck advisory references.
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: Tencent BrowserSkill through 0.3.0; local daemon WebSocket browser-client origin validation.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: Browser agents depend on faithful page state and screenshots; a malicious extension accepted as a client can alter the agent's perception and actions at the browser-control boundary.

upstream_routing.ai_wiki: Broad BrowserSkill product or browser-agent entity context.
upstream_routing.ai_security_wiki: Browser-agent origin validation and observation integrity.

qualifying_findings.confidence_notes: High confidence from CVE text and code reference; remediation version is not identified in the captured record.

qualifying_findings.title: vLLM bad_words cross-request logits corruption
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: CVE Services records cross-request logits corruption in vLLM through 0.29.0. SamplingParams.update_from_tokenizer fails to validate bad_words token indices against model generation output width, allowing authenticated attackers to supply out-of-bounds token indices that corrupt logits memory of concurrent HTTP requests and cause incorrect tokens.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: CVE Services primary record with upstream pull request, code references, and VulnCheck advisory reference.
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: vLLM through 0.29.0; bad_words sampling and concurrent HTTP request generation path.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: Multi-tenant model serving needs request isolation; cross-request logits corruption can undermine output integrity for other users even when confidentiality impact is not recorded.

upstream_routing.ai_security_wiki: Model-serving request isolation and output integrity flaw.

qualifying_findings.confidence_notes: High confidence from CVE text and upstream PR reference; exact fixed release should be verified because the record references a PR rather than an unaffected version.
follow_up_actions: Check PR #48824 merge status and release notes during ingest.
Route under model-and-prompt-security or infrastructure-and-supply-chain depending on local page granularity.

qualifying_findings.title: gensim model loader unsafe deserialization
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: CVE Services records unsafe deserialization in piskvorky gensim through 4.4.0. The affected Load function in gensim/utils.py handles Model Loader fname input. The record says remote attack is possible, public exploit material exists, and the issue was closed same-day without a comment, PR, or fix while unsafe pickle.load remained at develop HEAD.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: CVE Services primary record with VulDB technical reference and issue-tracker reference.
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: gensim 4.0 through 4.4.0; Model Loader SaveLoad.load path.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: Model and embedding artifact loaders are supply-chain execution boundaries; unsafe pickle loading can turn untrusted model artifacts into code execution.

upstream_routing.ai_wiki: Broad gensim or model artifact ecosystem context.
upstream_routing.ai_security_wiki: Model-artifact deserialization and unresolved remediation state.
